snapshot.head: 430776b5a0d9c899a067a64e682d90fed8c065e6
snapshot.scope: Read-only evidence/source inventory. No raw scientific arrays, compiler, model, solver, or tolerance changes.

decision.recommended_boundary: A current-source, one-cell/two-density UDM number-state transition check with partial cloud fraction and strictly partial activation, linking initialized/boundary QNN/QNC through scalar transport, UDM activation and return, then native radius input/output.
why_this_is_nonduplicative: The saved positive-Nc-stage evidence has four positive same-stage radius-helper matches but both activation-rate arrays are zero.
The saved positive-activation case has a fully active fraction branch at the selected point and the existing CCN floor raises NN; it does not meet a partial-activation, floor-inactive condition.
The fractional-CF case observes 0<CF<1 and positive NC, but does not establish a partial activation fraction or compare two dry-density states.

The existing NC radiative sensitivity compares conditional radius interpretations in a held manufactured radiation input; it is not an end-to-end host initialization/transport/process/radius contract.

proposed_acceptance.source_identity: Bind the current source tree and exact Registry, module_microphysics_driver, module_mp_udm, and actual selected input/producer path. Historical a91 and 8017 observer evidence remains historical.
state_conditions: Observed 0<CF<1 at the same process stage as the selected number state.
Observed 0<activation_fraction<1 and positive activation, with CCN minimum, cloud-number minimum/maximum, water cap, and other relevant repairs demonstrably inactive.

Two otherwise matched density cases use the same declared population basis and thermodynamic state; record QNN/QNC at producer/input, after transport, at UDM entry, after activation, after return, and at radius consumption.
Check each step with source-ordered native-kind arithmetic and report actual state transitions; do not infer a density multiplier from whichever arm better matches radiation.
proposed_acceptance.interpretation_limit: Until the producer/storage number basis is independently authoritative, this is an observational discriminator, not a physical PASS or justification to insert rho/CF scaling. If a basis cannot be stated, report the measurements and keep PHY-NC open.

why_not_other_gates_now: PHY-SIZE remains blocked on the exact pinned cloud-LUT generator population/habit/effective-size provenance; the retained Wyser moment audit explicitly does not authenticate that table recipe.
RFMIP's saved 2x2 is a selected 20-profile decomposition and retains the global strict failure; its next closure needs separate reference provenance/coverage work.

LBLRTM retains negative total OD and strict FAIL after the selected coupling ablation. Existing observer evidence is a separate spectroscopy-source-order task and does not supply a physical accuracy reference.
decision.software_boundary_note: The merged NetCDF scalar/namelist preflight work (PRs 150–151) and a scalar order-0 regression are I/O contract checks. They do not close the UDM number-unit/population contract.
